_readme: Lotus House, as one half of the two-house fixture for developing and testing the
cleaning team's app. The other half is scripts/cleaning-fixture-cosmos.example.json,
and the README section on this app has the commands that turn the pair into one merged
documents file. scripts/cleaning-fixture-payload.example.json is the older single-house
fixture and is kept on purpose: a payload naming no property is what a document from
before there was more than one house looks like, and every screen still has to render
Every code and every phone number below is invented and none of them opens or reaches
anything. The real ones live in as-operations/people-management/access-codes.md in the
document store and are never copied here.
The Thai queue titles are the ones Paul approved for this house, copied from
275645-cleaning.md, as is the cot note. The all-houses titles are English stand-ins:
once two houses are merged the per-house title is wrong on a screen holding both, and
the Thai for that one is still Paul's to write.
Dates move. Edit the jobs so some of them are in the future, or the whole fixture
renders as a schedule that has already happened.
